newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Lower Chamber of Deputies met to debate bill on ombootsman, who is to be elected by the upper Senate.
* The government holds its weekly session to discuss preparations ahead of the November 3 polls and put a number of state-run companies under financial surveillance.
* Romania hosts an air drill attended by NATO member countries and Partnership for Peace members organised on a military base near the Otopeni international airport.
* Romania has gone through the full cycle of military drills involving all types of NATO forces, a Romanian army official said.
* President Ion Iliescu promulgated the law on obligation for dignitaries to state their fortunes upon appointment in the state aparatus.
* Romania and Germany signed an accord for cooperation in fighting organised crime. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 REUTER
